start.title: سهل شنعار
start.text:
سهل أخضر واسع يمتد أمامك.
تجمع البشر كلهم هنا — شعب واحد، لسان واحد.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Settle and build a home
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You sink roots into the earth. It feels right.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Dream of something greater
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The horizon is not enough. You want the sky.

unity.title: لسان واحد
unity.text:
تختلط الأصوات. يعلو الضحك.
لا توجد كلمة لا تفهمها.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Praise God for the gift of unity
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You lift your voice in thanks. Others bow their heads.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Boast of what we could achieve
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Pride sparks in the crowd. Eyes turn upward.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Stay silent — listen to the elders
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Wise voices speak softly. Others shout louder.

proposal.title: الفكرة العظيمة
proposal.text:
ينهض شيخ. "لنَبْنِ برجًا — رأسه في السماوات."
"لنصنع لنا اسمًا."

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Cheer — join the great work
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your voice is one of thousands. The crowd roars.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Speak against it — this is pride
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Few hear you. But the words are spoken.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Wait — let others decide
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Silence is its own answer. The vote passes.

bricks.title: طوب وقار
bricks.text:
تشكل الطين الرطب إلى طوب.
إنها أقوى من الحجر. ستصل إلى السماء.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Work for the love of craft
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your hands move with care. The work itself is good.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Race the others — outshine them
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your speed turns to recklessness. Bricks crack.

construction.title: الطوابق الأولى
construction.text:
ترتفع الجدران. يلقي البرج بظلاله الطويلة.
يغني الرجال وهم يرفعون كل عارضة.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Boast — "We need no God now"
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Workers cheer. Above, the silence deepens.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Work quietly — say a prayer
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] No one hears. But the prayer is heard above.

rising.title: أعلى
rising.text:
عامًا بعد عام. حجرًا فوق حجر.
يخترق البرج الغيوم.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Doubt — should we stop?
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You whisper it. The wind carries the words away.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Climb higher — there is no limit
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The ladder feels endless. Your pride is fuel.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Demand the workers go faster
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Tempers fray. Hands bleed. The tower climbs.

summit.title: لمس السماء
summit.text:
تقف في القمة. الأرض صغيرة في الأسفل.
تشعر بأن السماوات قريبة — تكاد تكون في متناول اليد.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Reach upward — claim the sky
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your fingers find only wind. Yet you feel watched.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Kneel — feel suddenly small
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The vastness above swallows your pride.

gods_gaze.title: ينزل
gods_gaze.text:
صوت يملأ الأجواء، هادئ كالرعد.
"إنهم شعب واحد. لن يكون شيء مستحيلاً عليهم."

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Stand defiant before the voice
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your courage withers. The air grows heavy.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Bow your head in fear and awe
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your knees buckle. The presence is everywhere.

confusion.title: كلمات غريبة
confusion.text:
تصرخ في وجه صديقك. يحدق فيك.
يفتح فمه — لكن الأصوات لا معنى لها.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Force him to understand — shout louder
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Anger only deepens the void between you.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Step back — accept what God has done
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Tears fall. The wall between you is unbreakable.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Blame the elders — start a fight
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Fists fly. The tower bleeds men instead of mortar.

scattering.title: الخروج
scattering.text:
تجمع العائلات ما تستطيع.
تتجه كل مجموعة نحو أفق مختلف.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Curse the heavens as you leave
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Bitterness is a heavy load to carry.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Walk in silence, lesson in heart
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Each step is a small confession.

reflection.title: أرض جديدة
reflection.text:
تتوقف على تلة هادئة.
البرج بعيد خلفك — ذكرى كبرياء.
